entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Sequence is 405 aa and matches reviewed mycobacterial CoaBC references at 64.9–66.7% identity with approximately 98% query coverage; functional identification is homology-supported.

Bifunctional enzyme catalyzing two sequential CoA-biosynthesis reactions: CTP-dependent ligation of L-cysteine to (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate, followed by decarboxylation of the resulting N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine.
Reviewed reference annotations report Mg2+ and FMN as cofactors.

entities.name: CoaBC cysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP = N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:19397; EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: CoaBC decarboxylation
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ = (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; Rhea RHEA:16793; EC 4.1.1.36.
